solutions.title: Count current run while writing
solutions.strategy: Track the current value count and copy a number into the prefix only while its run count is at most two.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each array element is inspected once and kept elements are written once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the write index, previous value, and run count are stored.

solutions.title: Compare against two-back prefix
solutions.strategy: Write each value when fewer than two values are kept or when it differs from the value two positions behind the write index.

timeComplexity.explanation: The compacting pass performs one constant-time comparison per input value.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm mutates the input prefix using only one write index.
